statements.text: Cascade Renewables Fund III holds a majority stake in a renewable-energy generation platform.

expectedSupport.passage: We recommend an investment of EUR 200 million for a 70% stake in the holding company of a renewable-energy generation platform (the Platform).

statements.text: The platform benefits from long-term contracted cash flows and meaningful geographic diversification.

expectedSupport.passage: Diligence confirmed that the power purchase agreement counterparties are predominantly investment-grade utilities, supporting the durability of contracted cash flows.
The Platform's assets are distributed across four grid jurisdictions, providing meaningful diversification of merchant and regulatory exposure.

statements.text: The platform operates 1.2 GW of installed capacity.

expectedSupport.passage: The Platform comprises operational wind and solar assets totalling 1.2 GW of installed capacity across three countries.
Independent technical diligence confirmed installed capacity of 1.4 GW as of April 2025, not 1.2 GW as recorded in the initial memo, following completion of a solar phase during the diligence period.

statements.text: The fund targets attractive risk-adjusted returns underpinned by contracted revenue.

expectedSupport.note: source uses U+2013 en-dash in '20–24%'; a matcher passage returned with a hyphen will fail an exact substring match
expectedSupport.passage: Our base case generates a 2.6x MOIC and a gross IRR in the 20–24% range.
Diligence confirmed that the power purchase agreement counterparties are predominantly investment-grade utilities, supporting the durability of contracted cash flows.

statements.text: Aldous Renewables is the fund's largest limited partner.

expectedNoSupport.reason: lexical hook on 'Aldous Renewables' (named as co-investment partner, not an LP); does not support largest-limited-partner claim
expectedNoSupport.temptingPassage: The opportunity was sourced through the fund's relationship with Aldous Renewables, a long-standing co-investment partner.
